purpose: City parcel geometry and registry/cadastre research; local registry evidence and public vector geometry are assessed independently.
name: Sosnowiec

queries.query: Sosnowiec Poland official cadastral map parcels GIS geoportal ewidencja land registry WFS
queries.result: Found the official municipal geodesy page, municipal WFS endpoint, and national GUGiK EGiB/KIEG documentation.

queries.query: Sosnowiec oficjalny geoportal mapa katastralna działki ewidencja gruntów WFS Wydział Geodezji i Kartografii
queries.result: Znaleziono oficjalny serwis miasta wskazujący Wydział Geodezji i Kartografii oraz publiczną usługę WFS/WMS Sosnowca; dokumentacja GUGiK potwierdza krajowe usługi EGiB/KIEG.

officialSources.operator: Urząd Miejski w Sosnowcu, Wydział Geodezji i Kartografii
officialSources.observation: Official city page identifies the municipal geodesy/cartography department and links the public e-usługi service.

officialSources.operator: Urząd Miejski w Sosnowcu public WMS/WFS
officialSources.observation: Verified GetCapabilities identifies public WFS layer ms:dzialki (Działki), EPSG:2177 default CRS and EPSG:2180/EPSG:4326 alternatives.
Official documentation describes EGiB custody by counties/city counties and KIEG/ULDK national access services.

registryBasis: The official city page identifies the Wydział Geodezji i Kartografii and the city-hosted public WFS; this evidences a local registry/cadastre custodian, not citywide completeness.

requests.outcome: Capabilities retrieved; ms:dzialki parcel layer, CRS, public WFS operations and WGS84 extent inspected.
Schema retrieved. Safe geometry field is geometry; native identity candidate is ID_DZIALKI. Other returned fields were not retained.

requests.method: GET; anonymous; bounded WFS GML response
requests.outcome: Returned three polygon features, converted to a minimal GeoJSON sample with only canonical id properties. Service axis order required the bounded query order observed from the public response; WUP coordinates were not changed.
National KIEG capabilities retrieved for contextual cross-check; no feature geometry was retained from this aggregate WMS.

sourceCandidate.publisher: Urząd Miejski w Sosnowcu / Wydział Geodezji i Kartografii
sourceCandidate.scope: Public municipal cadastral parcel layer candidate; bounded anonymous geometry response verified.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: A bounded query around the unchanged WUP point returned nearby parcels; the response is not treated as proof that the exact point lies in a parcel or that no exact-point hit exists.
requestEvidence: Three-feature bounded GML response converted to minimal GeoJSON

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Sosnowiec WFS parcel layer and national GUGiK EGiB/KIEG context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous bounded parcel response from the municipal service.

safeFieldAllowlist: ID_DZIALKI as stable native parcel identity
remainingUncertainty: Only a bounded sample was requested and retained. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted. No citywide completeness, service freshness beyond the response timestamp, or adapter/runtime qualification is asserted. No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
